Container.Name: mcp-ynab
Container.Overview: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that connects Claude.ai to your YNAB budget. Allows Claude to read account balances, transactions, and category budgets in real time.

Config.Name: AppData Path
Config.Description: Where to store persistent config (API token, etc.). Settings are saved here so they survive container updates — just like Sonarr's AppData folder.

Config.Name: MCP Port
Config.Description: Port the MCP server listens on. Use this port when configuring Claude.ai remote MCP.

Config.Name: YNAB API Token
Config.Description: Your YNAB Personal Access Token. Generate one at https://app.ynab.com/settings/developer — only needed on first run; saved automatically to AppData after that.

Config.Name: YNAB Budget ID
Config.Description: Your YNAB budget ID (found in the URL when viewing your budget: app.ynab.com/budgets/YOUR-BUDGET-ID/). Leave as 'last-used' to auto-select your most recent budget.

Config.Name: MCP Client ID
Config.Description: OAuth client ID used when configuring Claude.ai remote MCP. You can leave this as 'mcp-ynab'.

Config.Name: MCP Auth Token (Secret)
Config.Description: A secret token to protect your MCP endpoint. Set any long random string here and use the same value when configuring Claude.ai. Leave blank to disable auth (not recommended if exposed to the internet).
